description: claude-toolkit quality hooks: format edited files, run affected tests, guard destructive commands, scan commits for secrets, desktop notifications, subagent output contracts, verified state after a compaction. Logic lives in `ctk hook <name>`.

hooks.command: command -v ctk >/dev/null 2>&1 && ctk hook guard-destructive; exit 0
command -v ctk >/dev/null 2>&1 && ctk hook secrets; exit 0
command -v ctk >/dev/null 2>&1 && ctk hook format-file; exit 0
command -v ctk >/dev/null 2>&1 && ctk hook affected-tests; exit 0
command -v ctk >/dev/null 2>&1 && ctk hook notify; exit 0
command -v ctk >/dev/null 2>&1 && ctk hook notify; exit 0
command -v ctk >/dev/null 2>&1 && ctk hook affected-tests; exit 0
command -v ctk >/dev/null 2>&1 && ctk hook notify; exit 0
command -v ctk >/dev/null 2>&1 && CTK_PLUGIN_ROOT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" ctk hook agent-contract; exit 0
command -v ctk >/dev/null 2>&1 && ctk hook continuity; exit 0
